limitations: Signal peptide, antigenic-region and topology results are rule-based screens written for this project. They are not SignalP, TMHMM, DeepTMHMM, PSORTb or BepiPred and should not be reported as their output.
Peptide windows are scored with a linear antigenic-propensity scale. This is not B-cell or T-cell epitope prediction and says nothing about MHC binding.

Host-similarity interpretation uses provisional thresholds: broad or partial similarity at 70% identity, 80% coverage as "most of the protein", moderate similarity from 30% identity, and identical peptide matches of 8 or more residues flagged. They are screening conventions, not validated cutoffs.

MHC binding and B-cell epitope results come from the IEDB Analysis Resource. They are predictions for a fixed allele panel and do not show that a peptide is processed, presented or recognised, or that it is immunogenic.
Hydrophobic regions and transmembrane candidates are sequence-based heuristics.
Localization evidence must come from an external prediction tool, database, or experiment.
Essentiality evidence is recorded from supplied sources and is not independently predicted.
Conservation depends on the supplied alignment and conservation definition.
Host-similarity evidence is based on supplied search results and does not independently establish absence of host similarity or vaccine safety.
